name: Eiffel Tower (Large)
description: The Eiffel Tower stands on the Champ de Mars in Paris, next to the Seine River, overlooking the prosperity of Paris. The Iron Tower was designed by the famous architect Gustave Eiffel and completed in 1889. The tower is 324 meters high and is a landmark building in France. Pinku uses a new spraying process to inject new energy into classics and show extraordinary texture.
